context.body: Dreams in confinement and before Pharaoh · Genesis 41:14–24
context.label: Dreams in confinement and before Pharaoh

observations.body: Joseph changes clothes, denies that interpretation is his own possession, and hears Pharaoh’s full account of the dreams.
observations.label: Joseph is brought from the dungeon before Pharaoh

observations.body: The passage presents Joseph is shaved, clothed, and brought before Pharaoh as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Joseph is shaved, clothed, and brought before Pharaoh

observations.body: The passage places Joseph says God will answer Pharaoh beside Joseph is shaved, clothed, and brought before Pharaoh.
observations.label: Joseph says God will answer Pharaoh

payload.posture: Read Genesis 41:14–24 as one movement in Joseph's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states joseph changes clothes, denies that interpretation is his own possession, and hears Pharaoh’s full account of the dreams. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Joseph's story.
payload.title: Joseph is brought from the dungeon before Pharaoh
